Remarks: For latitude, multiply degrees by 100, add minutes (to the nearest 0.1 minute), and then multiply by 10. Example: 42 degrees 51.7 minutes is 4251.7 multiplied by 10 and contains 42517.
For longitude, multiply degrees by 100, add minutes (to the nearest 0.1 minute), and then multiply by 10. Example: 42 degrees 51.7 minutes is 4251.7 multiplied by 10 and contains 42517.
Elevation is 2000m added and multiplied by 10. Example: 2.1m plus 2000m multiplied by 10 gives 20021
